mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hydra_volume (guid, name, volume_type, mapping_mode, allocation_mode, status, logical_size, committed_bytes, allocation_unit, stripe_unit, member_length, member_count, titan_root, object_root, version, ext_config) VALUES (#{guid}, #{name}, #{volumeType}, #{mappingMode}, #{allocationMode}, #{status}, #{logicalSize}, #{committedBytes}, #{allocationUnit}, #{stripeUnit}, #{memberLength}, #{memberCount}, #{titanRoot}, #{objectRoot}, #{version}, #{extConfig})
mapper.update: UPDATE hydra_volume SET name = #{name}, volume_type = #{volumeType}, mapping_mode = #{mappingMode}, allocation_mode = #{allocationMode}, status = #{status}, logical_size = #{logicalSize}, committed_bytes = #{committedBytes}, allocation_unit = #{allocationUnit}, stripe_unit = #{stripeUnit}, member_length = #{memberLength}, member_count = #{memberCount}, titan_root = #{titanRoot}, object_root = #{objectRoot}, version = #{version}, ext_config = #{extConfig} WHERE guid = #{guid}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hydra_volume WHERE status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY id ASC
